result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred limits for CGL, E&O, cyber/privacy when relevant data is processed, workers’ compensation, and certificates on request. However, it exceeds the playbook by requiring all coverage for one year after the term and by extending the cyber trigger to any “Corio” data, not just Customer Data. The existing substantive provisions are otherwise preserved, but the sections are presented out of numerical order and the insurance clause appears after the execution lead-in, reducing drafting quality.
